mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% signals persistent monetary accommodation, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate sustained low-cost capital.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% show no significant positive average (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, triggering immediate negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending expectations.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >50% of instances when UNRATE increases >0.5pp or Rank IC < -0.02 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings face dual headwinds.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 60-day returns in >60% of cases or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth above 105 (INDPRO) signals easing supply constraints and manufacturing expansion, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate margins.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO > 105 or Rank IC < 0.04 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls growth exceeding 150,000 monthly signals robust labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns show no significant positive average (t-test p > 0.05) when PAYEMS > 150,000 or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 0.3 percentage points monthly signals accelerating price pressures, triggering immediate negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as rate hike expectations rise.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >50% of cases when CPIAUCSL increases >0.3pp or Rank IC < -0.02 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate unexpected labor market contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as economic slowdown fears intensify.
failure_condition: Joint decline in UNRATE and PAYEMS fails to produce negative 5-day returns in >60% of cases or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth exceeding 2.5% annualized (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 > 2.5% annualized or Rank IC < 0.04 over 2-year rolling window.
